context: Ren and Yuki review a capital-raising plan.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: finance discussion; capital vocabulary (株/資金/発行/利益/税) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 事業の資金を、株で集めたいんです。
lines.en: I want to raise venture funds through shares.
lines.style: measured young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 株の発行は、いつ行いますか?
lines.en: When do we issue the shares?
lines.style: attentive office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 来月、新たに株を発行します。
lines.en: We'll newly issue shares next month.
lines.style: precise young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 集めた資金は、何に使いますか?
lines.en: What will the raised funds be used for?
lines.style: curious office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 資金は、工場の整備に充てます。
lines.en: The funds go toward upgrading the factory.
lines.style: measured young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 利益が出れば、税も増えますね。
lines.en: If we profit, taxes rise too.
lines.style: thoughtful office woman voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 税を引いても、利益は十分残ります。
lines.en: Even after tax, plenty of profit remains.
lines.style: confident young analyst voice, soft warm professional focus throughout

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 発行の手続き、すぐ進めますね。
lines.en: I'll move the issuance procedures along right away.
lines.style: reliable office woman voice, soft warm clarity closing throughout
